verdictReason: All three round-1 blocking/medium findings are genuinely fixed and independently re-verified, not just claimed: the original 10-snippet false-positive probe now returns 0/10 blocked (re-ran verbatim, unmodified), the word-boundary regression test now actually fails under a mutation that reverts word-bounded folding to naive substring matching (round 1's version would NOT have caught that regression), and the fail-open wrapping + input coercion eliminates every crash scenario from round 1's crash probe. The incident case still blocks. HOWEVER: probing the new SELLER-VOICE discriminator specifically (as requested) found a new, narrower false-positive class it introduces — human-interest/interview journalism that quotes a shop owner or community member using first-person 'our store'/'nossa loja' phrasing. 4 of 5 new adversarial-but-legit snippets were blocked, including a plausible lamley-style 'shop closes after 30 years, owner interviewed' piece and a PT t-hunted-style closing-interview piece — genres directly adjacent to the ones this fix was tuned against. Recommend either a small follow-up (don't let a seller-voice hit alone complete the bar together with only generic WEAK words like 'in stock'/'discount' — require a second STRONG, or require an actual CTA-flavored strong marker, not just presence) or an explicit, logged acceptance of this narrower trade-off (the same way SEC-PROMO-3/5 were explicitly accepted in this same commit). Not blocking release given the self-correcting [E035] alert/tuning loop already in place, but should not be left silently unaddressed.

round1FindingsStatus.verification: Re-ran the original, unmodified round-1 probe script (10 snippets: mattel_creations_discount, mattel_creations_store_url, premium_line_roundup, hobby_shop_closing_news, mattel_ecommerce_relaunch, pt_restock_loja_url, convention_exclusive_sale, secondary_market_coupon_mention, anniversary_sale_news, target_exclusive_drop) against the new code. Result: 0/10 blocked, matching the coder's claim exactly. The 4 previously-blocked snippets (Mattel Creations store drop, hobby shop closing, Mattel storefront relaunch, PT restock roundup) all now pass. Root-cause fix (URL token demoted STRONG->WEAK, seller-voice gate added) verified directly against source, not just via the new test file.

round1FindingsStatus.title: Word-boundary claim had no regression test that would actually fail if the guard broke
round1FindingsStatus.verification: Monkey-patched _promo_fold to a naive (non-tokenized, non-word-bounded) folder and re-ran TestIsPromoArticle. The NEW test test_word_boundary_guard_is_what_keeps_these_below_the_bar fails cleanly under this mutation (PT fixture: markers become ['nossa loja','estoque','desconto'] instead of [] because 'estoque'/'desconto' would wrongly match inside 'estoques'/'descontos'), proving it is a genuine regression guard — unlike the round-1 test, which passed vacuously regardless of boundary correctness. Two other tests also caught the same mutation as a side effect (marker-list assertions), giving 3 failing tests total under the mutation vs 0 under correct code.

round1FindingsStatus.title: _is_promo_article call site not wrapped in try/except; non-string link/entry crashes
round1FindingsStatus.verification: Re-ran the round-1 crash probe (link=int, link=list, entry=list/non-dict, title=None, paragraphs containing None/int/list items) directly against _is_promo_article: all 5 cases now return a marker list instead of raising. Call site in job() is now wrapped in try/except mirroring the dedup gate's Decision 12 pattern (fail-open, logs and treats as not-promo), and this is covered by a real integration test (test_promo_filter_crash_is_fail_open, patches _is_promo_article to raise and asserts job() doesn't crash and the article still reaches pending_articles).

The interview continues next week with a look at the shop's most memorable finds.' — a retrospective Q&A quoting the owner using two different seller-voice synonyms.

'Meet the Owner Behind a Local Hot Wheels Institution' — '"Our store is really just an extension of my own collection," the owner said, describing how the shop grew from a garage hobby into a full storefront over twenty years. He credits word of mouth and a loyal customer base for keeping the business alive through several industry downturns.' — same interview genre, but only ONE weak-adjacent signal total (control case to confirm the seller+weak boundary is still symmetric).

'Community Roundup: Collectors Share Their Best 2026 Finds' — 'Every month we round up highlights from the collector community Discord -- this time, a restock story from a regular member. "Our store finally got the new Boulevard wave back in stock this week," one member wrote, "and there was even a discount code floating around for early birds." As always, thanks to everyone who shares their pickups with the group.' — a fan/community member's own colloquial 'our store' (meaning 'the store we shop at'), not the shop itself speaking.

residualRiskAssessment.mechanism: The seller-voice gate ('nossa loja'/'our store'/'our shop' present) is a substring match with no concept of quotation marks, attribution, or speaker identity. A news article that quotes a shop owner, a community member, or an interview subject using first-person '(nossa) nossa loja'/'our store' phrasing is textually indistinguishable from ad copy to the detector, and only needs ONE more ordinary weak word (in stock/discount/estoque/desconto — words any such quote would naturally contain) to cross the bar.
residualRiskAssessment.scope: Narrower than round 1's gap: round 1 broke ordinary day-to-day retail/restock coverage (this channel's bread and butter). This residual gap is specific to human-interest/interview-style pieces (shop-owner profiles, closing-announcement interviews, retrospectives, community-roundup quotes) — a real but less frequent genre for lamley/t-hunted/autoevolution.
residualRiskAssessment.mitigatingFactor: Not fully silent: an [E035] alert still fires with the matched markers shown, and the alert's own copy explicitly invites the operator to report false positives for pattern tuning — so the existing feedback loop can catch and correct these, unlike a channel that had no filter and no alert at all.
residualRiskAssessment.recommendation: Either (a) don't let a bare seller-voice marker complete the bar together with only 2 generic WEAK words — require the second signal to be an actual CTA-flavored STRONG marker (cupom/buy now/use code/etc.), not just weak commerce vocabulary that any first-person quote would naturally contain, or (b) explicitly log this as an accepted trade-off in the session notes the same way SEC-PROMO-3 (homoglyph evasion) and SEC-PROMO-5 (pin permanence) were accepted-as-is with stated rationale, so it's a documented decision rather than an unexamined gap.
